summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from the official Bun GitHub releases (pinned to bun-v1.3.13), extracts it, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` bundled in the tarball. `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with hex-named identifiers and string-lookup indirection. `math_init.js` is a ~728KB `@bun-cjs` blob using a shift-based string-array decoder (`WV8StW`) and a large numeric/string constant dispatch table, with no corresponding source under `src/` and no reference to it in README or package.json beyond the setup script's `execFileSync` call. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute an opaque, obfuscated, undocumented payload at `npm install` time — under a package that presents itself as an MCP tools SDK — matches the alternate-runtime-dropper install-time-RCE shape: attacker-controlled code executes automatically on the installer's machine with no way for the installer to audit what runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
